description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Lucian''' fires a missile in the target direction that explodes in a cross pattern upon hitting an enemy or reaching maximum range, dealing magic damage to enemies hit and granting [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of the area for 1 second.
description.text: Active: Lucian fires a missile in the target direction that explodes in a cross pattern upon hitting an enemy or reaching maximum range, dealing magic damage to enemies hit and granting sight of the area for 1 second.

description2.raw: Enemies hit are marked for 6 seconds.
description2.text: Enemies hit are marked for 6 seconds.

description3.raw: '''Lucian''' gains [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] '''bonus''' movement speed for 1 second when he or allied champions damage a marked target. Allied champions triggering this effect grant '''Lucian''' ''[[File:Lucian Lightslinger.png|20xpx|border|link=Lucian#Lightslinger|An icon for Lucian's ability Lightslinger]] [[Lucian#Lightslinger|Vigilance]]''.
description3.text: Lucian gains  bonus movement speed for 1 second when he or allied champions damage a marked target. Allied champions triggering this effect grant Lucian Vigilance.

leveling.raw:
'''Magic Damage:'''
75 / 110 / 145 / 180 / 215 (+ 90% AP)

notes.raw: * This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time. ** Like most [[projectile|missiles]], it will not collide with enemies whose center is beyond the maximum range (not behind '''Lucian'''), but this determines only the center and timing of the explosion. * ''Ardent Blaze'' will cast from wherever '''Lucian''' is at the end of the cast time. * '''Lucian''' will not gain ''Ardent Blaze's'' bonus movement speed if attacks on marked targets are [[File:Jax Counter Strike old.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Dodge]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|dodged]], [[File:Spirit's Refuge.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Block]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|blocked]], or if missed while the attacker is [[File:Blind icon.png|20px|link=Blind|An icon representing the keyword Blind]] [[:Blind|blinded]]. * [[File:Blaze.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Persistent damage]] [[:Damage|DoTs]] will proc ''Ardent Blaze'' only once. * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] will not prevent the mark.
notes.text:
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
* Like most missiles, it will not collide with enemies whose center is beyond the maximum range (not behind Lucian), but this determines only the center and timing of the explosion.
Ardent Blaze will cast from wherever Lucian is at the end of the cast time.
Lucian will not gain Ardent Blaze's bonus movement speed if attacks on marked targets are dodged, blocked, or if missed while the attacker is blinded.
DoTs will proc Ardent Blaze only once.
Spell shield will not prevent the mark.
